manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Phantom Steed must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed for its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
